direct_original_clauses.literal_without_modern_punctuation: 置各平交日辰全分以平交加減定差加減之命甲子算外得正交日辰依發斂較之得時刻

source_local_operational_chain.original_formula: 右遲疾積度相減為損益損益以日率而一為捷法
source_local_operational_chain.role: construct 損益捷法 from degree difference and 日率
use 損益捷法 on the residual, then add/subtract 遲疾度全分 to obtain 平交入限遲疾度分

source_local_operational_chain.original_formula: 右置八百二十以遲行度而一為捷法
source_local_operational_chain.role: construct the distinct reciprocal-type 遲疾捷法
multiply 平交入限遲疾度 by limit-specific 遲疾捷法; 遲 gives 加差 and 疾 gives 減差
apply 平交加減定差 to 平交日辰全分; source explicitly proceeds to 正交日辰 and 時刻

grade_advances.new_positive: The two consumer roles and their signed day/time application now have same-copy Ming-print source-original support. The earlier received-only snapshot remains immutable and correctly scoped to its own evidence.

Conversion of angular/time 全分 and allocation of13TR factor100

G893 same-field numeric equivalence, six historical final controls and source-to-source genealogy

negative_boundaries: The original 12限20分 conversion is a directly read constant, not independent certification of a 日法, an exact820 reciprocal identity or a full-period mean.
No repeated fit of13TR seven numeric rows or replacement of its preserved contrary glyphs.
Same-copy construction/use chains are not proven transmission edges and do not authenticate a Yuan-era original.
Neither reduced whole-page atlas inspection nor extracting every image is exhaustive textual review. No claim of no surviving unit definition is made.
Source original target numeral/carry judgments cannot inherit authority merely from obtaining the complete PDF or directly proving the coefficient consumer.

explicit_non_edges: Within-copy original operational dependency is established; no G893-to-Xing direct copying, common archetype, independent-impression vote or unique historical generator is proved.

next: With full source access and the same-copy operator chain now closed, seek an explicit original definition of the angular/time 全分 and printed 微 coefficient representation, or a clear independent early print for the exact L35 raw rate and reciprocal. Do not repeat the now-certified source-local consumer clauses as if they closed numeric units or G893 carry.
